PLAN
- Stage 0 — Snapshot & flags (reversible baseline):
  - Tag current prod config as `cfg_v1`; pin model/tree/sizing params; add feature-flag wrapper around p_yes computation, tree arming, and model-layer sizing so every new component is independently toggleable.
  - Freeze current shadow logs as the control stream; do not alter safety gates (Wilson + FDR + min-n untouched).
- Stage 1 — Replay/backtest harness:
  - Build walk-forward replay over all 430+ settled bets plus shadow-only opportunities: recompute candidate p_yes, EV, size, and counterfactual P&L as-of each decision timestamp.
  - Validate harness by reproducing live decisions exactly on cfg_v1 (bit-for-bit on inputs; tolerance on floats).
  - Add metrics: Brier, log-loss, calibration slope/intercept, per-slice EV with Wilson CIs, turnover, exposure by hour/regime.
- Stage 2 — Feature layer v2 (offline, no behavior change):
  - Pre-register a fixed candidate feature set (cap ~20) to bound multiple testing: cross_model_std × lead_time, cross_model_std × settle_hour, model_run_age buckets (fresh/stale), inter-model disagreement (HRRR−GFS, HRRR−NAM spread and sign), ou_z × model_std, cloud/wind/dewpoint deviations vs climatology, regime flags (frontal/passage, diurnal phase).
  - Enforce as-of joins (no post-settle data); add leakage unit tests using synthetic future-dated rows.
  - Log features for all new bets (shadow); require ≥98% coverage before downstream use.
- Stage 3 — Calibrated p_yes v2 (shadow only):
  - Keep existing obs+HRRR residual blend as the base rate input; add a calibration head: isotonic or regularized logistic on [blend_output, cross_model_std, model_run_age, ou_z, disagreement] trained strictly walk-forward with embargo = settle window.
  - Hierarchical shrinkage: per-regime calibration pooled toward global calibration when slice n < 50.
  - Emit p_yes_v2 alongside v1; size and trade decisions remain v1.
- Stage 4 — Tree re-run on features v2:
  - Re-run adaptive tree restricted to the pre-registered feature set; existing Wilson + FDR + min-n gates unchanged.
  - Success = ≥1 surviving non-settle_hour split; prune/re-demote any existing 5c slice whose lower Wilson EV ≤ 0 on post-feature data.
- Stage 5 — Model-layer promotion path (SHADOW → limited live):
  - If shadow p_yes_v2 beats v1 (see CHECKPOINTS), promote to probability input only (not sizing) for 2 weeks.
  - Then enable sizing influence capped to a bounded multiplier band (e.g., 0.5×–1.25× of tree size), flag-gated.
- Stage 6 — Portfolio hygiene:
  - Demote or disable slices with posterior mean EV < 0 and upper Wilson bound < +2c; reallocate stake to armed slices only; keep total daily exposure ≤ current max.
- Stage 7 — Staged rollout:
  - Each promotion: 24h paper soak → 2-week eval window → promote/hold/rollback decision per DECISION_RULES; config changelog + auto-rollback hook on health checks.

RISKS
- Multiple-comparison blowup from new features → mitigated by pre-registered capped feature set + existing FDR; no ad-hoc feature additions mid-eval.
- Label leakage via as-of violations (obs revisions, model re-runs) → synthetic-future-row tests; embargo around settle time.
- Seasonal distribution shift: 430 bets may cover one weather regime; splits may not generalize → time-blocked walk-forward only; never random CV.
- Calibration head overfits small n → shrinkage to global; min-n before per-regime calibration activates.
- Harness divergence from live → Stage 1 equivalence gate blocks all later stages.
- Sizing multiplier amplifies a miscalibrated v2 → cap band; sizing promotion is last, not first.
- Silent feature degradation in prod (missing model run) → coverage alarms; auto-fallback to p_yes_v1 on stale features.
- Thin-slice churn: demoting/arming slices repeatedly → hysteresis: promotion and demotion thresholds must differ (demote bar lower).

CHECKPOINTS
- CP1 (Stage 1 exit): harness reproduces 100% of historical decisions; replay P&L == logged P&L within rounding.
- CP2 (Stage 2 exit): leakage tests pass; feature coverage ≥98% over last 200 logged opportunities.
- CP3 (Stage 3 exit, promotion gate): walk-forward shadow Brier(v2) ≤ Brier(v1) − 0.005 AND log-loss(v2) < log-loss(v1) over ≥300 out-of-sample settled events; calibration slope of v2 within [0.8, 1.25].
- CP4 (Stage 4 exit): ≥1 non-settle_hour split survives Wilson+FDR+min-n, OR documented null result after full pre-registered set (triggers pivot rule below).
- CP5 (Stage 5 probability promotion): v2-as-probability paper P&L over 2-week window ≥ v1 counterfactual; no slice's realized calibration error > 8c.
- CP6 (Stage 5 sizing promotion): shadow lower-Wilson EV > +2c/contract over ≥200 shadow
